title: Co-Modifying Application Code and Deployment Infrastructure: A Causal Study of AI Agent Pull Requests
title_zh: 协同修改应用代码与部署基础设施：AI Agent Pull Request 的因果研究
abstract_en: Current software engineering agents are evaluated predominantly inside isolated sandboxes against synchronous local tests. However, deploying features in collaborative repositories requires modifying continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines, containers, and provisioning manifests alongside application logic. Because agents lack deployment awareness, attempting cross-domain modifications introduces unverified dependencies into asynchronous integration pipelines. To isolate the causal integration overhead of dual-scope pull requests (PRs)-modifying both application code and deployment infrastructure-we evaluated 26,999 PRs across two large datasets (AIDev v5 and MOSAIC-3M) encompassing six agent architectures and an aligned human baseline. Using a deterministic four-tier file taxonomy and an exact 4D strata-matching framework, we isolated integration metrics under conditional exchangeability while controlling for application volume. We find agents operate primarily as application coders or chore workers, with maintenance tasks capturing 17.70% to 25.41% of agent PRs. Dual-scope modifications represent only 4.48% to 4.55% of agentic PRs, yet trigger bimodal integration outcomes. In the first mode, explicitly reviewed contributions experience protracted delays, adding a median penalty of +13.13 hours and multiplying time-to-merge by 3.24x, driven mechanically by CI/CD and provisioning manifests. In the second mode, maintainer gatekeeping exhibits a structural bypass: even for external contributors lacking repository write access, agent identity reduces the odds of human review by 63.7% compared to human peers. Consequently, 43.1% to 56.2% of dual-scope PRs bypass inspection to merge silently in a median of under 31 minutes. These uninspected modifications compromise build verification, demonstrating the need for deployment-aware benchmarks and strict path-based access controls.
abstract_zh: 当前软件工程 Agent 主要在隔离沙箱中通过同步本地测试进行评估，但在协作式代码仓库中部署功能，往往需要同时修改应用逻辑、CI/CD 流水线、容器配置和资源供应清单。由于 Agent 缺乏部署感知能力，这类跨域修改可能向异步集成流程引入未经验证的依赖。为识别双范围 PR（同时修改应用代码与部署基础设施）带来的因果集成开销，本文分析了 AIDev v5 与 MOSAIC-3M 两个大型数据集中的 26,999 个 PR，覆盖六种 Agent 架构及匹配的人类基线。研究采用确定性的四级文件分类体系和精确四维分层匹配方法，在控制应用代码改动量并满足条件可交换性假设的前提下比较集成指标。结果显示，Agent 主要承担应用编码或日常维护工作，其中维护任务占 Agent PR 的 17.70% 至 25.41%；双范围修改仅占 4.48% 至 4.55%，却呈现双峰式集成结果。其一，经过明确人工审查的双范围 PR 合并时间中位数增加 13.13 小时，达到普通 PR 的 3.24 倍，延迟主要由 CI/CD 与资源供应清单修改造成。其二，维护者把关出现结构性绕过：即使外部贡献者没有仓库写权限，Agent 身份仍使其接受人工审查的概率较人类贡献者降低 63.7%。最终，43.1% 至 56.2% 的双范围 PR 未经检查便被静默合并，合并时间中位数不足 31 分钟。这些未经审查的修改削弱了构建验证，说明亟需面向部署场景的 Agent 基准，以及严格的路径级访问控制。
key_points_zh: 研究覆盖 26,999 个 PR、AIDev v5 与 MOSAIC-3M 两个数据集、六种 Agent 架构，并设置对齐的人类贡献者基线。
双范围 PR 仅占 Agent PR 的 4.48% 至 4.55%，但会产生明显的双峰结果：接受审查时严重延迟，未审查时则快速合并。
经人工审查的双范围 PR 合并时间中位数增加 13.13 小时，time-to-merge 达到对照组的 3.24 倍，主要受 CI/CD 和 provisioning manifests 修改影响。
Agent 身份使外部贡献者获得人工审查的概率较人类同行降低 63.7%；43.1% 至 56.2% 的双范围 PR 未经检查即完成合并。
论文建议构建具备部署感知能力的评测基准，并对 CI/CD、容器及资源供应文件实施严格的路径级访问控制。

llm_assessment.comment: This empirical study provides durable evidence for deployment-aware coding-agent evaluation and operational gates, though it contributes no new harness itself.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该实证研究为部署感知的编码智能体评测和运行门控提供了持久证据，但并未提出新的运行框架。
